The .SRCINFO file for rclone-manager contains standard packaging metadata with no indicators of malicious activity. Source URLs point to the project's own GitHub releases (https://github.com/Zarestia-Dev/rclone-manager/releases/download/v0.3.3/), which is expected behavior for downloading upstream binaries. SHA256 checksums are provided (not SKIP) and are specific hash values, ensuring integrity verification. Dependencies are standard for a GTK-based GUI application (cairo, gtk3, webkit2gtk-4.1, etc.). The package options (!strip, !debug) and license (GPL-3.0-or-later) are consistent with normal Arch packaging practices. No suspicious network destinations, obfuscated code, dangerous commands, or data exfiltration patterns are present.
